observed_failure: Render backend https://otravelz-backend.onrender.com timed out (>120s) with 0 bytes returned from edge proxy (216.24.57.15).
verified_root_cause: render.yaml blueprint was bound to otravelz-db via fromDatabase property: connectionString.
Render free-tier database expired/deleted after 30-day limit (backup saved to backup_otravelz_render_20260904-1110.dump).
PostgreSQL migrated to Aiven Cloud, but render.yaml was never updated to decouple from otravelz-db.
Service startup in Render failed without valid DATABASE_URL, leading to suspension.
Render control plane requires human operator dashboard login to un-suspend.
configuration_repairs_applied: Decoupled DATABASE_URL from fromDatabase: otravelz-db in render.yaml and marked sync: false for secure dashboard injection.
Removed obsolete databases: block for deleted otravelz-db from render.yaml.
Configured CORS_ORIGINS default in render.yaml to include https://algoryxz.github.io, http://localhost:5173.
Added automatic GitHub Pages origin inclusion in backend/app/main.py CORSMiddleware.
Added machine-readable release identity contract on /health and / with git_sha, alembic_version, status, and database connectivity.
remaining_operator_actions: Under Web Services, click otravelz-backend and select Resume Service.
Under Environment, set DATABASE_URL to Aiven connection URI with sslmode=require.
Under Manual Deploy, click Deploy latest commit from feature/v4-platform-rebuild.
